verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Durable ingress, subscription fan-out, durable queuing, and terminal dead-letter handling are strongly covered, including write-before-ACK, one-delivery-per-endpoint expansion, retry policy, maximum attempts, preserved DLQ context, inspection, and identity-preserving replay.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The outbound delivery contract is incomplete: no customer endpoint is represented, no idempotency key is attached to the call, and timeout and network-failure retry triggers are missing. The 2xx category is shown but is not explicitly connected to delivery completion.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents most of the architecture and operational lifecycle, especially durable ingestion, fan-out, queuing, signing, retry scheduling, DLQ preservation/replay, pause retention, and visibility. However, several system-defining delivery and failure semantics are absent, so the board cannot fully replace the brief as a visual acceptance record.
